test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-II Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some kings are drills.

All clamps are drills.

Conclusions:

(I) Some kings are clamps.

(II) All drills are clamps.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/425efcf53bc9cb529911fe6c2ba0197035035cfc9ec753ca23e3aa9ecd306896.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some kings are clamps - **False** (Because there is no definite relation given between kings and clamps, so it is only a possibility).

(II) All drills are clamps - **False** (Because all clamps are drills, but the reverse is not necessarily true).

So, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
